subject: Data-address-identifier
notes: kb/Work PB1408 landed: both arms fixed at the one accessor (AddressOfRestriction), and SET ADDRESS OF's data-name-1 side (SR19 second sentence) now asks the same accessor, so a based restricted pointer is of its own type there too. Derivation: GR2: the data-address-identifier is restricted to 'the type of identifier-1'. A restricted data-pointer is a typed item (13.18.60.3 SR18 admits the restriction only in a type declaration, reached by TYPE), so its type is its own TYPEDEF (TypedItemType), never the type its value addresses; a strongly-typed group nested in a strong record is typed by its position in the declaration (8.5.3.1 second alternative: TypeRestriction.Member). One accessor feeds SET Format 7 sender and receiver, the CALL/INVOKE address-identifier argument and the conformance descriptor key.
